charter: Find defects that make the change set hard to read, hard to change, or inconsistent with local style.

inputs.summary: Review report_builder for names, comments, and structure.

issues.title: BuildReport is camelCase in a snake_case module
issues.whats_wrong: The public function uses Java-style camelCase instead of snake_case.
issues.why_it_matters: Callers and later editors will not find the helper next to apply_line_items-style names.
how_to_fix: Keep the JSON shape the same.
acceptance_criteria: The public function name is snake_case and matches neighboring modules.
issues.suggested_test: none — rename only; update call sites if any

issues.title: Opaque names data, tmp, and x hide intent
issues.whats_wrong: raw is copied to data; tmp is an accumulator; x is a row counter.
issues.why_it_matters: A future editor cannot tell which list is the input rows vs the scratch buffer.
how_to_fix: Rename data to rows, tmp to scratch_rows or drop it, x to row_number.
acceptance_criteria: No variable named data, tmp, or x remains in the function.

issues.title: Comments restate the next line
issues.whats_wrong: Comments say set default list, increment counter, and append row.
issues.why_it_matters: Narrative comments go stale and hide the one invariant worth writing down.
how_to_fix: Keep a comment only if a non-obvious VAT or comp rule needs it.
acceptance_criteria: No comment that repeats the following assignment remains.

issues.title: One function mixes mapping, VAT, comps, and serialization
issues.whats_wrong: A single function maps fields, applies comps, assigns VAT, and dumps JSON.
issues.why_it_matters: A tax change requires editing the same 50-line concern soup as JSON wrapping.
how_to_fix: Extract row mapping and VAT/comp rules into helpers named for those jobs.
acceptance_criteria: VAT/comp rules live in a helper whose name states that concern.
issues.suggested_test: test_build_report_applies_eu_vat — still passes after the split
issues.do_not_change: EU VAT 0.2 and US VAT 0.0 results.
